posts.title: Cotswold Open 2026 Report
posts.description: If you are expecting another tale of me ending up triumphant like Coventry in February, I’m going to temper your expectations. This one went significantly worse. The Cotswold Open was held at The King’s School Gloucester, a beautiful location that was thankfully easy to get to via train so no hotel for me this time.
